title: sorbus trilobata
intro: Sorbus trilobata, commonly known as the Whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in reducing stress, improving sleep, and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus trilobata include analgesic and anti-fever activities, which can help alleviate pain and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
